originality.rationale: The identified contributions are the exact support-palette necessary/sufficient criterion for four-cycle basins on complete split graphs with arbitrary clique size, all six first-periodic-entry layer polynomials, and the nontrivial fixed-core probability limit. Accessible related older mathematical claims were compared by implication rather than titles. The historical four-color complete-tripartite specialization K_{1,1,n} corresponds to m=2 and thus covers aspects of the coarse special-case period classification; it does not supply the all-m first-entry counts. The full 2016 three-color arbitrary-graph paper explicitly separates four-color CCA as a harder regime, and the 2021 tree paper studies threshold >= 2 on infinite regular trees. No identified prior source derives the assessed formulas for arbitrary m,n; residual unindexed equivalents are possible.

value.rationale: Four-color CCA has antipodal non-interacting color pairs, which create a genuine structural competition between frozen core/periphery configurations and self-sustaining color cycles. Complete split graphs model the natural dense-clique/peripheral distinction and give a two-parameter infinite graph family. A precise iff activation criterion, all six exact first-entry shells, sharp three-step cutoff, periodic-orbit counts, and a nontrivial fixed-core limiting active probability resolve a motivated dynamical invariant with future use in comparing topology and finite color support. Not merely a numerical finite-case extension or generic period existence statement.
